title: Quarterly roadmap: Harbor activation model and tenant readiness scoreboard for Private/VPC/on‑prem
creator: Priya Kapoor
description:
Summary: Establish a repeatable quarterly roadmap to enable enterprise Private/VPC/on‑prem rollouts via a three-wave 'Harbor' activation model and a tenant readiness scoreboard. Goal is to reduce time-to-first-production-tenant by 40% and lower upgrade rollback rate to <2% over the quarter.

Scope:
- Define Harbor activation model (Wave 0 pilot anchors, Wave 1 early adopters, Wave 2 broad activation).
- Build tenant readiness scoreboard: automated compatibility checks, security posture, capacity reservation, and SLA entitlements.
- Gate rollouts with telemetry-driven acceptance checks (latency, error rates, KV cache hit, resource headroom).
- Coordinate engineering deliverables for compatibility shims, private control-plane upgrade-runbook, and canary rollback automation.
- Create operational playbooks for Customer Success and Solutions Engineering (pre-check checklist, onboarding timeline templates).

Why now: Momentum from recent Dedicated customers has increased demand for predictable Private deployments. Current ad-hoc rollout process creates friction and prolonged onboarding for regulated tenants. A repeatable activation runway preserves safety while enabling higher velocity.

Success metrics (quarter):
- Time from signed order to first tenant activation <= 6 weeks for tier-1 customers.
- Activation rollback rate <= 2% across all waves.
- Readiness scoreboard coverage >= 90% of targeted tenants before Wave 1.
- 40% reduction in manual pre-checks logged by Solutions Engineering.

Stakeholders: PM (owner) Priya Kapoor, Eng leads (Runtime: Maya Chen; Infra: Daniel Ortiz), Product Reliability: Leila Morgan, Solutions & CS: Aaron Blake, Security & Compliance: Meera Singh.

Key decisions to make this quarter:
- Finalize Harbor wave definitions and anchor tenant criteria (latency SLA, number of concurrent connections, encryption profile).
- Adopt a single canonical readiness scorecard and schema persisted in the Control Plane.
- Define the telemetry gating thresholds for auto-promote vs. manual-gate.
- Circuit-breaker behavior on capacity shortfall: pre-reserve cluster floor vs. soft-warning with throttling.

Deliverables (this ticket):
1) Harbor activation runbook draft, with wave taxonomy and expected SLAs.
2) Tenant readiness scoreboard spec and sample JSON schema for control-plane ingestion.
3) Acceptance gating matrix (telemetry signals + pass/fail thresholds).
4) Cross-functional rollout calendar and responsibility matrix.
5) Pilot plan for 3 anchor tenants including required infra reservations and SRE on-call schedule.
acceptance_criteria: Harbor runbook document published to Confluence with sign-off from Eng, Security, and CS
Readiness scoreboard schema committed to control-plane repo and basic UI mock in Console
Telemetry gating matrix validated against historical pilot data and thresholds agreed
Pilot run scheduled with at least 1 anchor tenant and documented rollback plan
Dependencies (ENG) have delivery windows that align with pilot dates
